notes:
Core is 13 long-list items plus 3 missing (16), well short of 30: in this category the evidence only supports that many. Many places residents orient by (Stortorget, Malmö Opera, Stadsbiblioteket, Emporia, Malmö Arena, the churches, Ribersborgs kallbadhus, Moriska paviljongen, Västra station, Malmö Saluhall) are already in the game or in other category lists (handel, scen, krog, kyrka, museum).
Kockumskranen was dismantled in 2002 and moved to Ulsan, South Korea; it is not a quiz item. Varvsstaden is a locality/district name, not a building.
Malmö Studenthus is the building everyone calls 'Kinesiska muren' (Rosengård); its high page views come from news about its problems. Use that name if it goes in.
Teschska palatset is the Apoteket Lejonet building on Stortorget; 'Apoteket Lejonet' is the name people know.
Hippodromen overlaps the in-game 'Malmö Stadsteater' (Hipp is its main stage); Orkanen and Caroli kyrka are in the game already but did not make core here (Caroli belongs with churches).
Kronprinsen is in both handel and here: pick one.
Hyllie station and Triangeln station are core but already in the game. Lernacken and Ön are areas, not buildings. Sjöbefälsskolan, Ribersborgs skansen and Hylliemöllan were not found in OSM under those names.
Other byggnadsminnen listed by malmo.se and not checked further: Beijerska huset, Sjöbergska palatset, Gamla riksbanken, Djäknegatshusen.
